propositions: Read-only derivations over git history and working tree must expose code-health metrics (module-size distribution, cap-change events, short-term churn, refactor-to-addition ratio) against a single flat hard cap in .github/module-size-limit.txt.

Four deterministic metric functions must scan src/rebar/**/*.py at a ref against the cap, parse git log --numstat for churn/refactor ratio, and detect commits changing the limit file, returning correct totals and ratios or None when no insertions exist.

Each of the four metric ids (module_size_distribution, cap_change_events, churn, refactor_to_addition_ratio) must be registered in REGISTRY with lens='code_health', source='git', confidence='high', and a context-adapter compute callable.

Unit tests must verify module_size_distribution returns exact count/max_loc/over_cap_count against a fixture tree, churn returns exact summed insertions/deletions, cap_change_events returns a list of dicts with old_limit/new_limit or an empty list, and refactor_to_addition_ratio returns the exact ratio or None.
All four git-metric registrations must be discoverable in REGISTRY with the correct labels and remain sourced from git history without writing state.
